description: Use this when a Phorme coach reads an answer their AI coach gave and says how they would say it instead. It keeps the coach's version; every later answer that finds this question leads with it. Send the question, the answer unchanged and the coach's own fix. Set confirmation to true only after the coach approved the fix as written.

brain_id.description: The brain id of the coach's own build, for example "cameron".

confirmation.description: True only after the coach approved this fix.

fix.description: How the coach would say it, in their own words.

name: correct_my_coach
title: Correct my coach
